title: Blueprint Seed Carving — first concrete population beneath reusable schemas
purpose: Begin filling the blueprints with actual entities rather than leaving the schemas abstract. These seeds are concrete research records and are deliberately structured for later expansion and source attachment.
rule: A seed is not a completed encyclopedia entry. It is a real entity with a defined graph role, inherited blueprint and explicit next-depth requirements.

records.name: Catholic Church
records.description: The largest communion within Christianity, centered institutionally on the Bishop of Rome/Pope and a worldwide network of dioceses, parishes, religious orders, schools, hospitals and charitable institutions.

records.name: Eastern Orthodox Church
records.description: Family of autocephalous and autonomous Eastern Orthodox churches sharing Orthodox theology, sacramental life and episcopal tradition.

records.name: Oriental Orthodox Churches
records.description: Family including Armenian Apostolic, Coptic, Syriac, Ethiopian, Eritrean and Malankara Orthodox traditions, historically separated from Byzantine Chalcedonian Christianity after fifth-century Christological disputes.

records.name: Anglican Communion
records.description: Global communion of Anglican and related churches shaped by the English Reformation, episcopal polity, common prayer traditions and diverse theological currents.

records.name: Lutheran traditions
records.description: Christian traditions originating in the sixteenth-century Reformation associated with Martin Luther and confessional Lutheran theology.

records.name: Reformed traditions
records.description: Reformation traditions associated with figures such as Calvin and Zwingli, later developing into Presbyterian, Congregational and other Reformed bodies.

records.name: Methodist traditions
records.description: Christian traditions arising from the eighteenth-century Wesleyan revival, emphasizing disciplined discipleship, preaching, community and practical holiness.

records.name: Baptist traditions
records.description: Diverse Protestant traditions emphasizing believer's baptism, congregational life and religious liberty, with substantial theological diversity.

records.name: Pentecostal traditions
records.description: Christian movements emphasizing the Holy Spirit, spiritual gifts, healing, conversion and experiential worship; highly diverse and globally distributed.

records.name: Sunni Islam
records.description: Major Islamic tradition organized historically around Sunni hadith, jurisprudence, theology and communal authority traditions.

records.name: Shia Islam
records.description: Major Islamic tradition emphasizing the religious authority and succession of the Prophet Muhammad's family, with diverse branches and schools.

records.name: Theravada Buddhism
records.description: Buddhist tradition strongly associated with the Pali Canon and monastic/lay institutions across Sri Lanka and mainland Southeast Asia.

records.name: Mahayana Buddhism
records.description: Broad Buddhist family characterized by Mahayana sutras, bodhisattva ideals and diverse philosophical and devotional traditions.

records.name: Vajrayana Buddhism
records.description: Buddhist traditions using tantric methods, initiation, visualization and ritual technologies, prominently developed in Tibet, the Himalayas and elsewhere in Asia.

records.name: Vaishnavism
records.description: Hindu devotional traditions centered on Vishnu and/or his avatars, especially Krishna and Rama, with multiple theological schools.

records.name: Shaivism
records.description: Hindu traditions centered on Shiva, including devotional, philosophical, ascetic and tantric forms.

records.name: Shaktism
records.description: Hindu traditions centered on Devi/Shakti as divine power, expressed through diverse devotional and tantric forms.

records.name: Orthodox Judaism
records.description: Modern Jewish family emphasizing binding authority of halakhic tradition, Torah and rabbinic interpretation, with internal diversity.

records.name: Reform Judaism
records.description: Modern Jewish movement originating in nineteenth-century Europe and developing diverse approaches to halakhah, ritual and modernity.

records.name: Conservative/Masorti Judaism
records.description: Modern Jewish movement seeking continuity with halakhic tradition while permitting historical and communal development.

records.name: Baháʼí administrative order
records.description: Administrative structure of the Baháʼí Faith centered on elected spiritual assemblies and the Universal House of Justice.

records.name: United Nations
records.description: Intergovernmental organization founded in 1945 around international peace, security, cooperation and a broad institutional system.

records.name: European Commission
records.description: Executive and policy institution of the European Union with roles in proposing legislation, enforcing EU law and managing programmes and the EU budget.

records.name: European Central Bank
records.description: Central institution of the Eurosystem responsible for euro-area monetary policy and related financial-system functions.

records.name: World Bank Group
records.description: International development-finance group providing financing, research and policy support through several institutions.

records.name: International Monetary Fund
records.description: International institution focused on monetary cooperation, macroeconomic surveillance, lending and capacity development.

records.name: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
records.description: Intergovernmental security alliance founded in 1949 around collective defence and political consultation.

records.name: European Union treaty framework
records.description: Treaty-based legal framework establishing EU institutions, competences, rights and internal market arrangements.

records.name: North Sea energy system
records.description: Integrated research object covering offshore wind, oil and gas legacy infrastructure, electricity interconnection, hydrogen proposals, ports and industrial demand around the North Sea.

records.name: Greenland critical-mineral system
records.description: Research system covering Greenland's mineral potential, licensing, extraction constraints, infrastructure, ownership, export routes and geopolitical dependencies.

records.name: European electricity grid
records.description: Cross-border electricity transmission and distribution system linking national grids, generators, storage and consumers.

records.name: North Atlantic submarine cable network
records.description: Research layer for submarine telecommunications cables connecting Europe, Iceland, Greenland, North America and other nodes.

records.name: European container-port system
records.description: Network of ports, terminals, shipping routes, rail and inland logistics connecting European production and consumption to global trade.

records.name: Semiconductor manufacturing system
records.description: Technology and industrial system spanning semiconductor design, lithography, wafer fabrication, packaging, materials, equipment and supply chains.

records.name: Large language model technology
records.description: Machine-learning technology based on large-scale neural models trained on text and other data, with applications in language, coding and multimodal systems.

records.name: Electric vehicle system
records.description: Transport technology system coupling batteries, vehicles, charging infrastructure, electricity grids, minerals, manufacturing and regulation.

records.name: Industrial Revolution
records.description: Long historical transformation involving mechanization, fossil energy, factories, urbanization, labour reorganization, transport and large-scale productivity change.

records.name: Second World War
records.description: 1939–1945 global war involving major state coalitions, mass mobilization, genocide, industrial warfare and a major reordering of international institutions.

records.name: Protestant Reformation
records.description: Sixteenth-century European religious transformation involving theological disputes, institutional rupture, printing, political authority and new Christian confessions.

records.name: Copenhagen
records.description: Capital of Denmark and a major node for government, finance, research, shipping, culture and Nordic institutional networks.

records.name: Rotterdam
records.description: Major European port and logistics-industrial node connecting maritime trade to inland European transport and energy systems.

records.name: Brussels
records.description: Capital of Belgium and a major institutional center for European Union and international organizations.

records.name: Istanbul
records.description: Major Turkish metropolitan and transport node spanning Europe and Asia and connecting Black Sea, Mediterranean, Balkan, Caucasus and Middle Eastern systems.

records.name: Catholic social teaching
records.description: Body of Catholic teaching concerning human dignity, social order, labour, property, solidarity, subsidiarity and the common good.

records.name: Modern environmental movement
records.description: Broad family of movements concerned with ecological protection, pollution, climate, conservation and sustainable resource use.

records.name: Labor movement
records.description: Broad historical family of workers' organizations, trade unions, socialist and labour parties and campaigns for workplace rights and social protection.

records.name: World English Bible
records.description: Public-domain modern-English Bible translation used as a source corpus in the repository, with book/chapter/verse structure retained for citation and analysis.

records.name: Pew global religious composition estimates
records.description: Global religious composition dataset covering seven broad religious categories for 2010 and 2020 across 201 countries and territories.

records.name: Eurostat government debt dataset
records.description: Official European statistical source for government debt and GDP-related fiscal observations used in country records.

records.name: FIGARO input-output tables
records.description: European supply-use and input-output framework connecting industries, products, trade and employment for economic-network analysis.

records.name: European R&D system
records.description: Research and development sector linking public budgets, universities, companies, researchers, patents, scientific output and innovation.

records.name: European pharmaceutical sector
records.description: Sector connecting pharmaceutical research, regulation, manufacturing, procurement, healthcare demand and international supply chains.

records.name: European agri-food system
records.description: Food production and distribution system linking land, water, farms, labour, machinery, processing, logistics, retail and households.

records.name: North Atlantic Treaty
records.description: Founding treaty establishing NATO's political and collective-defence framework.

records.name: Paris Agreement
records.description: International climate agreement under the UNFCCC establishing a framework of national climate commitments, reporting and cooperation.

records.name: North Sea offshore wind resource
records.description: Renewable energy resource and industrial system centered on offshore wind potential, seabed rights, turbines, ports, cables, grids and electricity markets.

records.name: European freshwater system
records.description: Cross-border research layer for rivers, lakes, groundwater, water supply, agriculture, industry, ecosystems and water governance.

records.name: Arctic ecosystem
records.description: Large ecological system affected by sea ice, warming, marine productivity, terrestrial ecosystems, wildlife, Indigenous communities and resource development.

records.name: North Sea ecosystem
records.description: Marine ecosystem coupled to fisheries, shipping, offshore energy, ports, pollution, coastal habitats and multiple national jurisdictions.

population_status: Seeded concrete records across religious traditions, denominations, institutions, political/social movements, technologies, infrastructure, events, places, source documents, sectors, treaties, resources and ecological systems.
next_carving: For each seed, fill inherited blueprint fields from authoritative sources, then generate time-bounded relationships and promote mature high-value records into canonical node registries.
